frontend_smoke.evidence: In-app Browser offline homepage smoke at desktop and 390x844. Baseline reproduction showed that an empty first-question submit displayed the existing validation alert but left focus on Continue. After the change, the same submit focused the first status radio; at the birthday step a missing month focused the month select and a selected month with a missing day focused the day input, with the existing exact validation messages and no navigation. Both viewports then completed all ten questions through the Enter submit path, focused previewTitle, rendered the share card, preserved the local-preview checkout guard, and had no horizontal overflow. The production API base stayed blank, and final localhost requests were page/assets only with no API request. Question order, answer data, radio auto-advance, preview, share/referral experiment, tracking, API, checkout, and paid-flow behavior were unchanged. This digest invalidates the evidence on later frontend changes.

paid_flow_e2e.evidence: Narrow digest waiver for moving focus to the unresolved free-quiz control on an existing validation failure. The script.js change adds one requestAnimationFrame focus helper called only after the existing free-question error messages; the full-report HTML change is cache-revision synchronization only. The change does not alter validation decisions or copy, question data, answer persistence, tracking payloads, checkout creation, payment verification, paid-answer submission, webhook handling, queueing, report generation, Resend delivery, or customer responses. Offline desktop/mobile Browser QA covered all three error-focus targets and completed the free preview with the production API base blank, preserved the local-preview checkout guard, rendered the existing share card, and made no API request. No Lemon Squeezy transaction, webhook, report, or email was created; production payment/email E2E remains separately unauthorized, so this waiver is SKIPPED evidence rather than payment or fulfillment proof. Any later paid-flow digest change invalidates this waiver.
